**data-ai-daily-brief 2.0.0 Changelog**

- 3-phase search strategy (targeted → expanded → source tracing)
- 3-layer summary extraction with byte-level truncation
- Monday 72h time window for weekend coverage
- Anti-duplicate push lock mechanism
- Source attribution enforcement for every news item

- Added .github/FUNDING.yml to enable funding links.
- Refined SKILL.md with stricter information sourcing and acceptance principles: "宁缺毋滥" (quality over quantity), with clearer requirements to leave Product & Tech sections blank if lacking qualified updates.
- Enhanced Analyst Insights section: now explicitly includes global and domestic research institutions, and mandates that all securities analyst reports be categorized here, not under product or tech.
- Updated workflow for WeChat Work (企业微信): summary no longer includes hyperlinks—sources are text only, and links appear only in HTML version.
- Clarified content acceptance rules and board categories to improve reporting precision and transparency.

- Initial release of the AI-powered daily industry brief generator.
- Automates searching, filtering, writing, and structured delivery of high-quality Data+AI daily briefs.
- Strict filtering: Only impactful, first-hand news relevant to data platforms included; excludes generic AI and secondary sources.
- Supports customizable coverage for multiple industries (FinTech, HealthTech, Cybersecurity, etc.) via config.
- Generates professional briefs in Markdown and HTML formats, applying a detailed, structured report template.
- Built-in support for push notifications across 9 major channels, including WeChat Work, DingTalk, Feishu, Slack, Discord, Telegram, Teams, Email, and GitHub Pages.
